text: きんが　いっぱい　でたら　カントーに　マイホームを　かうぞ！

structure.jp: きんが　いっぱい　でたら
structure.en: if lots of gold comes out

structure.jp: マイホームを　かうぞ！
structure.en: I'll buy a home of my own!

patterns.name: 〜たら
patterns.explanation: たら on a verb means 'if' or 'when' that happens. でたら = 'if it comes out'.

patterns.name: 〜ぞ
patterns.explanation: ぞ at the end is rough, manly speech that pushes what you say with force. かうぞ = 'I'm going to buy it!'
